summary: Phase 2a Live Camera Detection testing completed. All regression tests passed - Phase 1 Manual mode remains fully functional. Camera mode is successfully integrated with graceful fallback, debug overlay, and proper UI state management. All features tested in Bahasa Indonesia.

Setup screen: CameraPreview visible in Camera mode with status pill showing 'CARI · 0 mk · 0 fps'

Library screen: All 5 tabs work (Karakter, Aktivasi, Booster, Skenario, Matriks Fusi)
